info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Referrals-v1-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Referrals API enables organizations to retrieve a comprehensive list of applications for referral-based positions. This endpoint is designed to support HR professionals and recruiting teams in managing their referral processes effectively. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline the referral tracking process, ensuring that all relevant applications are efficiently processed and evaluated. Typical consumers of this API include hiring managers and recruitment software systems looking to enhance their candidate sourcing capabilities.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access and retrieve a list of referral applications available within the system. It can be used to view all referral applications submitted by users.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving referral application details. The request payload should conform to the specified JSON schema, which defines the structure and required fields for correctly querying referral information.

204.description: Request completed successfully, no content to return.

ListCareersApplicationsReferralsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on applications referral. It is expected to be a string representing the content of the application JSON.
